    p.add_argument("--answers", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true")
    args = p.parse_args()
    rows = json.loads(open(args.answers).read())
    print(f"quick probe: {len(rows)}/{len(rows)} candidates present")


if __name__ == "__main__":
